items: 【Modern Minimalist Nightstand Design】This night stand set 2 combines a pure white finish with natural wood grain elements, creating a warm yet stylish visual appeal. The textured 3D wood grain drawer adds a tactile sense of depth and modern aesthetics, making it a perfect addition to any home décor style and an elegant highlight for your bedroom space.

【Multi-scenario Use】Night stands features the perfect size and height to complement most beds, chairs, and sofas. Versatile and adaptable, it can be used as a coffee table, bedside nightstand, end table, or sofa side table, seamlessly blending into your living room, bedroom, or any cozy corner of your home.

【Spacious Storage Nightstand】This small side table includes a well-designed drawer and a large open storage compartment. The spacious open shelf is ideal for displaying lamps, clocks, plants, or picture frames, adding warmth and a personalized touch to your room. The wide side tables tabletop offers additional space to showcase picture frames, mugs, lamps, or alarm clocks, meeting both functional and decorative needs.

【Premium Quality Materials】Crafted from high-quality MDF, this small nightstand ensures durability and stability. The premium waterproof surface is easy to clean and resistant to scratches. With small end table’s fine structure and careful craftsmanship, this bed side table promises long-lasting use and a worry-free experience.

【Easy Assembly & Our Commitment】white night stand comes with all necessary hardware, detailed assembly instructions, and tools for quick and hassle-free setup by a single person. Our exceptional customer service guarantees peace of mind—no more concerns about missing or damaged parts. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out, and we will respond within 24 hours to provide a satisfying solution.
